card.title: Entities and Repositories With Spring Data JPA

a1.cap: Model a Book entity (id, title, author, year) and a repository that can find books by author, search titles containing a keyword (case-insensitive), and list books published after a year, newest first, without writing SQL.

lines: Model a Book entity (id, title, author, year) and a repository that can find books by author, search titles containing a keyword (case-insensitive), and list books published after a year, newest first, without writing SQL.

a1.cap: An @Entity class maps to a table. Extending JpaRepository gives you CRUD operations for free, and Spring Data derives queries from method names such as findByAuthor.
a1.say: An at Entity class maps to a table. Extending Jpa Repository gives you CRUD operations for free, and Spring Data derives queries from method names such as find By Author.

a1.cap: For anything complex, use @Query with JPQL instead of very long method names.
a1.say: For anything complex, use at Query with JPQL instead of very long method names.

a1.cap: @Entity maps this class to a database table named book.
a1.say: at Entity maps this class to a database table named book.

a1.cap: The database generates the primary key with an identity column.
JPA needs a no-argument constructor; making it protected keeps it out of normal use.
Extending JpaRepository gives save, findById, findAll, delete, paging and more, with no implementation.
a1.say: Extending Jpa Repository gives save, find By Id, find All, delete, paging and more, with no implementation.

a1.cap: Spring Data reads the method name and generates WHERE author = ?.
a1.say: Spring Data reads the method name and generates WHERE author =?.

a1.cap: Containing plus IgnoreCase becomes a case-insensitive LIKE '%keyword%' query.
a1.say: Containing plus Ignore Case becomes a case-insensitive LIKE '%keyword%' query.

a1.cap: Even the sort order can be part of the method name.
For anything clearer written by hand, @Query takes JPQL with named parameters.
a1.say: For anything clearer written by hand, at Query takes JPQL with named parameters.
